'''Kamar''' was a dry and arid [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Kamarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[Howlrunner/Legends|howlrunner]]. It had [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] across its surface that scorched under the hot-white [[Star/Legends|sun]]. Various [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life such as the [[miser-plant]], [[Barrel-scrub/Legends|barrel-scrub]], and [[sting-brush]] sprouted up.

Other creatures native to Kamar included [[digworm]]s, [[stingworm]]s, [[bloodsniffer]]s, and [[nightswift]]s.

==History==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3668 BBY]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Akaavi Spar]] was born into [[Clan Spar]] on Kamar.<ref name="TOREncyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
Decades later, a space battle took place above Kamar and consequently, several valuable shipwrecks drifted in the orbit around Kamar and were slowly being pulled to the planet's surface.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Orbital Graveyard}}</ref>
